_about: Modified UNIFAC 2.0 (N. Hayer, H. Hasse, F. Jirasek, Modified UNIFAC 2.0 - A Group-Contribution Method Completed with Machine Learning, Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 64 (2025) 10304-10313; https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.12962), CC BY 4.0. Subgroups with R, Q and main group; the a (K) and b (-) tables of the main groups, a[i][j] and b[i][j] for main groups main[i] and main[j], Psi = exp(-(a + b T)/T). Written by validation/python/mod_unifac_2.py from the arXiv files in validation/data/unifac/mod-unifac-2.0/ (unchanged). The atoms of each subgroup (for the atom balance) are the thermo library's (MIT; thermo.unifac.DOUFSG), with the corrections of mod_unifac_2.py; null where it has none.
